module.title: Outpatient
module.description: Doctors' chambers: weekly schedules, serials with the fee on the patient's bill, free follow-ups, the waiting-room screen and the doctor's own patient list.

serials.title: Today's serials
serials.text: Serials for {date}. Tap the next step as the patient comes and goes.
serials.empty_text: Tap "Give a serial" to book a patient with a doctor.
serials.cancel_text: The place opens for someone else; the number is not given again. While the bill is open its fee comes off.
serials.refund_in_billing: Serial cancelled. The bill is already final: give any refund in Patient billing.

book.title: Give a serial
book.text: Find the patient, pick the doctor's session, give the serial. The fee goes on the patient's bill.
book.no_patient: No patient found. Check the spelling or register them.
book.no_sessions_text: Pick another day, or set the doctors' weekly schedules.

slip.title: Serial slip {number}
slip.footer: Please come a little before your time and keep this slip.

queue.title: Waiting room
queue.stale: Could not refresh; these numbers may be old.

mine.title: My patients
mine.not_linked: Your sign-in is not linked to a doctor
mine.not_linked_text: Ask the manager to pick you as the doctor's sign-in in "Weekly schedules".

schedules.title: Weekly schedules
schedules.text: When and where each doctor sits, and how many serials a session takes.
schedules.no_doctors_text: Add doctors first (Outpatient → Doctors), with their fee code from Patient billing.
schedules.sign_in_text: The staff member who is this doctor. Then "My patients" shows their patients, and with "doctors see only their own patients" they see only those.
schedules.no_sign_in: No sign-in (the desk writes for them)
schedules.no_sessions: No sessions yet. Tap "Add a session".
schedules.remove_hint: A removed session stops taking serials; serials already given stay.

serials.title: How to run today's serials

steps.2: When the patient comes, tap "Arrived"; when called, "Call in".

tips.1: "Screen" opens the waiting-room screen of a chamber: numbers only, never names.
tips.2: Cancel takes the fee off an open bill; a final bill is refunded in Patient billing.

serials.settings: Serials a session, free follow-up days and SMS are in the Outpatient settings.

book.title: How to give a serial

steps.1: Find the patient or register a new one.
steps.2: Pick the doctor and date: free serials show.
steps.3: Take the fee and give the slip.

tips.1: Follow-ups within the set days are free.

book.settings: Free follow-up days are in the Outpatient settings.

steps.1: "Call in" the next patient who has arrived.
steps.2: Open their name for history and reports.

tips.1: Prescriptions come in the next update.

doctors.title: How to set up doctors and chambers

steps.1: Enter the doctor's name, BMDC number and fee code.
steps.2: Add the chamber, then the doctor's weekly schedule here.

tips.1: The fee code is a service in "Services and prices" (Patient billing).
